headline: Commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road, flood pump station upgrades, and enforcement orders on three properties.
summary: The agenda includes a continued notice of intent for commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road. It also lists flood pump station upgrades and three enforcement orders.
items: Notice of intent from the City Engineering Department for flood pump station electrical upgrades, sluice gate replacements, and building repairs at multiple sites
Notice of intent DEP WE# 186-0306, continued from 8/27/26: commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road within a wetland buffer zone
Enforcement order at 98 Lower Westfield Road for illegal dumping and altering of wetland within 200 feet of Tannery Brook
Enforcement order at 461 Northampton Street for tree and shrub removal and a large wood chip pile in the 100-foot buffer zone
Enforcement order at 5 Appleton Street, continued from 09/24/26, for grading and fill along about 470 feet of Connecticut River banks
Discussion of upcoming items for the 10/22/26 meeting
location: Remote meeting by Zoom or phone

# Holyoke Conservation Commission

October 8th, 2026

6:15 PM

OCT 02 2026, Holyoke City Clerk's, Holyoke, MA

**This meeting will be held remotely, in accordance with temporary changes to Open Meeting Law. Access to this meeting is available to the public by computer or phone as follows:**

- Computer Access: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89934115730?pwd=Lub32w5G4BBZZqjea7r4wDj3ZRPl0e.1
- Phone Access: Call +1 309-205-3325 and enter the Meeting ID followed by: 895 2116 5144

Contact Joseph Pellegrino for questions about meeting access: pellegrinoj@holyoke.org or 413-322-5615

(All meetings are recorded)

1. Call to Order
2. Notice of Intent
   - Applicant: City of Holyoke, Engineering Department
   - Representative: Tighe and Bond
   - Location: Multiple Sites
   - Description: The proposed project includes electrical upgrades to the existing Flood Pump Stations #1 through #7, sluice gate actuator replacements at Tailrace Structure #6 and the Tailrace Intake and Gatehouse Structures #24, as well as limited building envelope repairs at Flood Pump Stations #5 through #7
3. Notice of Intent DEP WE# 186-0306 - Continued from 8/27/26
   - Applicant: Salmar Realty, Inc.
   - Representative: R. Levesque Associates
   - Location: 500 Easthampton Road (MBP: 213-00-003, 212-00-001)
   - Description: Commercial redevelopment within the Buffer Zone of Bordering Vegetated Wetlands
4. Enforcement Order
   - Location: 98 Lower Westfield Road (MBP: 174-00-021)
   - Description: Illegal dumping and altering of bordering vegetated wetland within the 200' buffer of Tannery Brook
5. Enforcement Order
   - Location: 461 Northampton Street (MBP: 223-00-011)
   - Description: Removal of tree and potentially shrubs in the 100' buffer zone of a resource area. Large chipper staged in 100' buffer zone and created large pile of wood chips measuring approximately 20'(L)x6'(W)x6'(H) in 100' buffer zone
6. Enforcement Order - Continued from 09/24/26
   - Location: 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006)
   - Description: Grading and fill deposition along approximately 470 lineal feet of banks within Riverfront, Banks, and Priority and Estimated Habitats of Rare Species associated with the Connecticut River. Fill sediments and associated debris were observed eroding down the steep bank towards the water.
7. Discussion - Chairperson Position
8. Formal Vote - Minutes from 8/13/26 meeting
9. Discussion - Upcoming Items for 10/22/26 Meeting
10. Mail/other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair
11. Adjourn
